description:
Rocket.Chat is open at the login screen in the browser. Log in with:
- Username: admin
- Password: Admin1234!

Then open the public channel #release-updates (preloaded with real release announcements from the official Rocket.Chat GitHub releases feed), find the announcement for release 8.1.0 (published 2026-02-10), and post this exact follow-up message:
"QA follow-up: 8.1.0 release review completed. Tracking link: https://github.com/RocketChat/Rocket.Chat/releases/tag/8.1.0"
